subtitleOverflow: Subtitles extend beyond the canvas. Reduce the font size or split the text into more cues.
title: Video composition
localNote: Stored only in this browser, isolated by account. Limits: 250 MB per draft, 600 MB and 16 drafts per account, 300 seconds per video. Composition assets and drafts are not uploaded.
exportCodecNote: Format depends on browser encoding support
deleteConfirm: Delete this local draft and its rendered video? This cannot be undone.
noVersions: No completed videos in this project. Generate one on the digital human page first.
selectedHint: Select multiple versions in the desired order. Speech comes from the finished videos; TTS is not played again.
noProjects: No local digital human projects for this account.
sourceMissing: The linked project does not exist or belongs to another account.
exportNote: Real-time foreground encoding; keep this page visible. Exports MP4 when supported, otherwise an actual WebM. Remote media must allow cross-origin access.
empty: Choose completed digital human video versions to start composing.
moveHint: Drag the person frame to move; drag its bottom-right handle to resize. Focus the frame and use arrow keys (Shift for larger steps), or use the numeric inputs.
mediaTimeout: Media loading or encoding timed out. Check the source and retry.
mediaFailed: Cannot decode this media, or the remote URL blocks cross-origin access. Use a local video or a cross-origin-enabled URL.
crossOrigin: Remote media blocks Canvas cross-origin access. Download the video and import the local file before exporting.
durationLimit: Include at least one video and keep the total duration within 300 seconds.
ownerRequired: Sign in to edit local drafts.
assetLimit: Too many assets, clips or subtitles (80 assets / clips, 2000 subtitles maximum).
invalidTrim: The in point must precede the out point and both must be within the source duration.
invalidLayout: The person frame is outside the canvas.
invalidSubtitle: Invalid subtitle timing: start must precede end and stay within the video duration.
capacityLimit: Local storage limit reached. Download and remove unneeded drafts or rendered videos.
storageFailed: Could not save the local draft. Check browser storage space.
storageBlocked: Another tab is blocking draft storage. Close it and retry.
audioBlocked: The browser blocked audio. Click play or export again.
encodingUnsupported: This browser cannot encode video. Use a recent Chrome or Edge.
encodingFailed: Browser video encoding failed; no video was created.
foregroundRequired: Export stopped because this page moved to the background. Keep the page visible and retry.
fileTooLarge: An individual background asset exceeds 100 MB.
unsupportedFile: Choose an image or video file.
